source.title: Belfast News-Letter, 17 May 1961, p. 5 ("County and rural council nominations")
source.publisher: Belfast News-Letter (via the Irish News Archive)
source.check: the unopposed returns read in the News-Letter nomination report of 17 May 1961.

note: Triennial election of Ballycastle Rural District Council, polled Thursday 1 June 1961. There was no contest; two new councillors were returned unopposed and are the only members named in the nomination report. New councillor. Returned unopposed.
